evidence: README and metadata identify Berkeley, CA but do not explicitly state timestamp timezone.
Raw timestamp solar peak is around hour 21; after UTC->Pacific conversion it peaks around local hour 14, consistent with daylight.
All hour/day/weekend/holiday features are generated after UTC->Pacific conversion.
Raw 10:00-12:00 UTC maps to early morning Pacific time for much of the data, so apparent late-morning emptiness was a timezone artifact before conversion.
